TOURISM & PLACE · SEASONAL DEMAND

Find the rhythm of demand.

Explore monthly accommodation nights and the concentration of visitors across the year.

Why compare countries? Comparing visitor numbers, seasonal demand and spending helps tourism boards understand different markets and identify what to research before planning promotion. The focus country is the country you want to explore; the reference country is the country you compare it with. For travel agencies, these national figures provide background—not package prices, customer demand or expected profit. Choosing trips also requires destination-level hotel prices, flight availability and customer preferences.
National context, local decisions

16 selected countries with energy and tourism data. National totals cannot reveal neighbourhood crowding.
